name: altcanvas
description: Self-hosted AI Research Workspace based on Altero and Zotero-compatible data

scripts.test: node test/bff.test.mjs && node test/bff-flow.test.mjs && node test/ai-provider.test.mjs && node test/canvas.test.mjs && node test/canvas-ui.test.mjs && node test/dev-logger.test.mjs && node test/native-m1.test.mjs
scripts.build:reader: node scripts/run-logged.mjs npm --prefix vendor/reader ci && node scripts/run-logged.mjs env NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider npm --prefix vendor/reader run build
scripts.build:web-library: node scripts/run-logged.mjs npm --prefix vendor/web-library ci && node scripts/run-logged.mjs npm --prefix vendor/web-library run build
scripts.build:vendor: npm run build:reader && npm run build:web-library
scripts.build:css: node scripts/run-logged.mjs npx tailwindcss -i styles/input.css -o styles/altcanvas.css --minify

author: sadgen
